name: assistant
description: Personal Assistant — notes, schedule, expenses, AI

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @assistant/shared build && pnpm -r --filter @assistant/backend build && pnpm -r --filter @assistant/frontend build
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec backend sh -lc "cd /app && node ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d dist/database/data-source.js migration:run"
scripts.prod:backup: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile backup run --rm backup
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .turbo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo node_modules/.cache
